evidence.summary: 捕获DSH成功文件编辑并集中展示差异，支持Keep/Revert、评论、撤销及VCS变更导入。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 src/index.ts、src/pending.ts、src/persist.ts、src/atomic-write.ts、src/client/markdown-preview.ts、package.json；成功工具结果fold为全局按路径pending，lineage/workspace过滤，RPC决策经宿主fs写回，单JSON持久与内存undo。
limitations: 核捕获、pending/lineage、持久、普通回退/删除与undo、预览净化；未全面审计VCS解析/所有UI和AI评论，不运行目标。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 编码用户在宿主中事后审阅已发生的修改，验收决定与实际文件一致，不当写前审批。
成功工具结果fold为全局按路径pending，lineage/workspace过滤，RPC决策经宿主fs写回，单JSON持久与内存undo。
核捕获、pending/lineage、持久、普通回退/删除与undo、预览净化；未全面审计VCS解析/所有UI和AI评论，不运行目标。
MIT0.36.1，Host/Client分导出，diff/marked/DOMPurify/Shiki依赖；宿主API耦合需固定版本核。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 客户端/字体/依赖与备份 | 核宿主、理解回退和留存 | 金额/时间未知 |
| 持续使用 | old/new快照、JSON/diff与外改检查 | 逐文件/块审阅，AI评论另计费 | 全局快照隐私和规模未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 备份/重写/部分恢复 | 查已写和持久日志、冲突修复 | 非事务，创建删除不可undo |
单人可备份工作树试用；普通回退先冻结其他写入，删除先确认，保留Git/备份和持久日志核查。参见[Q04](#research-q04)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 审阅接线 | 捕获/块/评论/决策 | 漏审与人工时间下降 |
| 归属 | lineage/workspace视图和请求策略 | 未知workspace/多源符合预期 |
| 恢复 | undo预检、部分计数、重试保存 | 无损回退/断电/多进程耐久 |
Pending状态与I/O分离、内容缓存、策略归属和rename退避值得复用；全局按路径快照不能误当按workspace隔离，写时内容版本和耐久需补契约。
把工具捕获、差异/评论与文件决策连成连续审阅，lineage视图与请求方策略分离可借鉴；算法依成熟库。参见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。
普通回退不做写时版本比较、创建删除不可undo，持久失败不拒动作成功；外改检测/undo预检不能当无损保证。参见[Q03](#research-q03)。
未验证假设为expected hash动作收据、删除恢复包及显式持久结果，批量按已写状态恢复；故障对照检查丢改/误报。参见[Q04](#research-q04)。

technical.rationale: novelty是既有diff集成；mechanism路径fold/lineage与策略分离有实质组合；transferability可移植但宿主fs/RPC耦合；simplification集中文件/块/评论减少跨工具交接。

business.rationale: workflow把捕获到决策集中有实质改进；delivery仍改代码/审阅小幅变化；reach便利宿主用户；economics可能减少切换但恢复负担未测，仅小幅。

recommendation.reason: 单人可备份工作树可试用事后审阅，回退前冻结外写并核实际文件，创建删除不可undo且持久失败需查日志。

scenario.rationale: 编码差异审阅反复且明确。

advantage.rationale: 工具捕获/块决策/评论接线比手工Git有增量。

evidence.rationale: 固定源码关键状态链，无宿主恢复实测。

cost.rationale: 人工审阅无强制模型，但快照/冲突/恢复责任较大。

# dsh-diff-approval > 捕获DSH成功文件编辑并集中展示差异，支持Keep/Revert、评论、撤销及VCS变更导入。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[9087/dsh-diff-approval](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval) - **版本号**：0.36.1（[固定提交 c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/tree/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-23（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 捕获/展示/恢复接线有源码支持；普通回退竞争、不可undo删除与持久弱确认限制无损承诺；动作收据未验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：编码用户在宿主中事后审阅已发生的修改，验收决定与实际文件一致，不当写前审批。 - **亮点**：把工具捕获、差异/评论与文件决策连成连续审阅，lineage视图与请求方策略分离可借鉴；算法依成熟库。参见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。 - **思考**：普通回退不做写时版本比较、创建删除不可undo，持久失败不拒动作成功；外改检测/undo预检不能当无损保证。参见[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：未验证假设为expected hash动作收据、删除恢复包及显式持久结果，批量按已写状态恢复；故障对照检查丢改/误报。参见[Q04](#research-q04)。 采用建议：单人可备份工作树试用；普通回退先冻结其他写入，删除先确认，保留Git/备份和持久日志核查。参见[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 核心贡献 把工具捕获、差异/评论与文件决策连成连续审阅，lineage视图与请求方策略分离可借鉴；算法依成熟库。参见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 关键质疑 普通回退不做写时版本比较、创建删除不可undo，持久失败不拒动作成功；外改检测/undo预检不能当无损保证。参见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证假设为expected hash动作收据、删除恢复包及显式持久结果，批量按已写状态恢复；故障对照检查丢改/误报。参见[Q04](#research-q04)。 未运行目标。隔离外改竞争、创建删除、磁盘满和批量中断，核文件字节、已写计数及重启状态。 ## 场景与替代办法 编码用户在宿主中事后审阅已发生的修改，验收决定与实际文件一致，不当写前审批。 IDE/Git差异加手工恢复是参照；插件省宿主交接，但不覆盖所有shell写或替代版本控制。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | |---|---|---|---| | 宿主fs/connection/workspace/session等 | 启动必需 | 捕获/RPC/策略 | 停用，外部审阅工具 | | 客户端模块/React | 界面必需 | 差异/评论展示 | 无审阅面板 | | Git/SVN/Perforce CLI | 导入可选 | 读取本地变化 | 仅自动捕获或手工比较 | | 备份/可写存储 | 恢复必需 | 真实回退/重启保存 | 停止破坏动作，先核日志 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 1 | 用户备份并固定宿主启用 | 工具变化捕获正确 | | 2 | 用户事后审差异/评论 | 接受或回退前核当前文件 | | 3 | 用户验证回退/undo/持久 | 实际字节一致；删除/故障走备份 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次使用 | 客户端/字体/依赖与备份 | 核宿主、理解回退和留存 | 金额/时间未知 | | 持续使用 | old/new快照、JSON/diff与外改检查 | 逐文件/块审阅，AI评论另计费 | 全局快照隐私和规模未测 | | 失败恢复 | 备份/重写/部分恢复 | 查已写和持久日志、冲突修复 | 非事务，创建删除不可undo | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 审阅接线 | 捕获/块/评论/决策 | 漏审与人工时间下降 | | 归属 | lineage/workspace视图和请求策略 | 未知workspace/多源符合预期 | | 恢复 | undo预检、部分计数、重试保存 | 无损回退/断电/多进程耐久 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：集中差异审阅的贡献、归属与回退恢复的一致性边界是什么？ ### Q01 · 集中审阅增加什么，是否构成写前审批？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 DSH编码用户可集中查看成功edit/write/editor产生的差异，逐文件/块Keep/Revert，评论与复制行引用，也可导入Git/SVN/Perforce本地变更。合格交付是看清哪些变化已发生、哪些被接受/恢复，以及实际文件与决定一致。相对切到IDE/Git工具，增量是把工具捕获、宿主差异展示、评论和恢复动作连起来。 捕获发生tools/result且需成功结果，文件在审阅前已修改；Keep是接受已有变化，不是事前批准。名称approval不能推为写前防护，也不能捕获所有shell写。算法使用diff/marked/DOMPurify/Shiki等既有库，贡献集中接线、状态和交互，不是新diff算法。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[README.md:11-16](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/README.md#L11-L16) 作者集中差异定位。 ```text A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for pending-change review: it automatically tracks every successful `edit`, `write`, and editor (`str_replace_editor`) mutation, folds them into a single pending list in the sidebar where each file's diff can be reviewed and kept/reverted — and it can also import the workspace's version-control repository's local changes (Git / SVN / Perforce) in one click. ![Pending changes panel](docs/images/pending-panel.png) The panel also collapses its file list into a floating card; while floating, each of its four edges — the left sidebar, the header above, the right sidebar, the composer below — can be chosen to be covered (all four is what used to be fullscreen, and covering nothing is a plain floating card), and it can dock as a tab in the right sidebar: ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:2484-2496](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/src/index.ts#L2484-L2496) 成功结果后捕获。
查看原文（13行） ```text ctx.on('tools/result', (exec: Readonly, result: Readonly) => { if (exec.name === 'str_replace_editor') { void captureEditorMutation(exec, result) return } if (result.isError || exec.agent === undefined) return const outcome = exec.name === 'edit' ? editOutcomeOf(result.value) : exec.name === 'write' ? writeOutcomeOf(result.value) : undefined if (outcome === undefined || outcome.oldText === outcome.newText) return const sessionId = exec.agent.id const entry: PendingEntry = { id: outcome.path, sessionId, ...outcome, updatedAt: Date.now(), sessionIds: [sessionId], lineage: lineageOf(sessionId, exec.agent), unseen: true } // Fold synchronously so the very next list sees the capture; persistence // (hydration + save) rides the same turn asynchronously. if (store.fold(entry)) persistSession() ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[package.json:71-80](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/package.json#L71-L80) 依赖来源。
查看原文（10行） ```text "dependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths": "^0.1.0-rc.5", "@shikijs/langs": "^4.4.3", "diff": "^9.0.0", "dompurify": "^3.4.15", "marked": "^18.0.11", "shiki": "^4.4.3" }, "peerDependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/cordis": ">=4.0.1", ```
### Q02 · 状态怎样聚合、持久与按会话展示？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 PendingStore按绝对路径全局唯一，后续同路径fold保最早基线、最新内容并累计sessionIds。正式持久为一个pending.json v3，源码明确不同于README“每workspace一个JSON”的说明。list/action用lineage root相等且同workspace过滤；未知workspace维持旧允许答案，不能当多租户强隔离。 undo/redo在内存按lineage root共享，实际写入记录发起动作座位的policySession，避免借另一会话宽权限。持久采用同实例串行写，捕获1秒节流、用户动作force；tmp+rename对EPERM/EACCES/EBUSY有限退避。状态/I/O分层和内容版本缓存值得借鉴，但全文件快照、单全局JSON与跨进程写无锁有规模/留存负担，rename不等fsync耐久。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/pending.ts:103-128](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/src/pending.ts#L103-L128) 路径fold与sessionIds聚合。
查看原文（26行） ```text * Combine a stored entry and a new capture. `oldText` comes from the earlier capture (the file's * original basis) — except where that capture was the file's creation and this one edits it, when * the creation's own content becomes the basis — and `newText` from the later (latest content). * The session set is the union, so the entry always spans the whole pending change regardless of * which session contributed which part. */ private mergeEntry(a: PendingEntry, b: PendingEntry): PendingEntry { const earlier = a.updatedAt <= b.updatedAt ? a : b const later = earlier === a ? b : a const sessionIds = [...new Set([...touchedBy(a), b.sessionId])] // A creation is the whole change only while creations are all there is: the entry is anchored at a // path that did not exist, and `earlierVersion: 'none'` is what makes a revert remove the file. As // soon as a later capture EDITS that file, the reader is reviewing rounds of work on a file that // exists, so the basis becomes the content it was created with and `回退` writes that back, keeping the // file. Freezing the field at 'none' (the rule from 2026-08-31 until now) left a file that had been // rewritten many times still tagged 新增 and still offering 删除. const onlyCreations = earlier.earlierVersion === 'none' && later.earlierVersion === 'none' return { ...later, // The global identity is the path; `id` must always equal it. id: later.path, // With no old side of the file's own to keep, the creation's content is the basis: `earlier.newText` // is the file as it stood right after it was created. oldText: onlyCreations ? '' : earlier.earlierVersion === 'none' ? earlier.newText : earlier.oldText, earlierVersion: onlyCreations ? 'none' : 'file', sessionIds, ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/persist.ts:1-15](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/src/persist.ts#L1-L15) 实际全局pending与旧布局迁移。
查看原文（15行） ```text /** * Durable pending-entry persistence under the harness home: one global JSON * file holding one entry per file path (across all sessions and workspaces), at * `/pending.json`; the default root is `/diff-approval/workspaces` * and the plugin's `storageDir` config relocates it. Saves rewrite the whole * file (the entry set is small), staged as a sibling temp file and atomically * renamed, so a crash leaves either the old or the new file. A missing file * reads as empty; corrupt content and unknown versions throw. * * Legacy layout: the pre-global schema stored one JSON file per workspace * (`/.json`, `{ version: 2, sessions: { [sessionId]: * PendingEntry[] } }`). On first load without a global file, `loadAll` scans for * those files, flattens every session's entries, and reports them so the caller * can fold them into the global store once; `save` then writes the global file * and deletes the legacy files. ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/persist.ts:180-195](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/src/persist.ts#L180-L195) 实例内串行。
查看原文（16行） ```text /** * Replace the persisted entry set durably. Saves to the one file are * serialized; a previous save's failure does not block the next one. On a * legacy migration this also removes the per-workspace files. * @param entries - the complete entry list, possibly empty. * @returns resolution after the file is durable. */ save(entries: readonly PendingEntry[]): Promise { const task = async () => { await writeJsonAtomic(this.globalFile, { version: FILE_VERSION, entries }) await removeLegacy(this.root) } const tail = this.tails.get(this.globalFile) ?? Promise.resolve() const run = tail.then(task, task) this.tails.set(this.globalFile, run.catch(() => {})) return run ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:1559-1594](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/src/index.ts#L1559-L1594) 可见性和未知workspace语义。
查看原文（36行） ```text * The rule is ROOT-EQUAL **AND SAME-WORKSPACE**: an entry is visible when any session that touched it * walks to the same lineage root as the requester AND can be shown to sit in the requester's workspace. * Walking is `knownLineageOf` links only, so a teammate's rows appear in the lead's list (both walk to * the lead) and the lead's appear in the teammate's — while a host fork, which names a parent but is not * a subagent child, stays an independent root and shares nothing. * * The workspace half is not redundant with the lineage half, because NOTHING ELSE IN THE LIST PATH * SCOPES BY WORKSPACE: the store is one map keyed by absolute path persisted to one `pending.json` under * the storage root (`pending.ts`, `persist.ts` — the `workspaces/` component of the default path is the * legacy per-workspace layout, folded in and deleted on load). So without this a row recorded by a * session in ANOTHER workspace would be listed here whenever the two share a lineage root — which is a * real shape: this view merges every subagent child (see the KNOWN LIMIT below), and the harness's * out-of-process shape lets a child run under a configured `cwd` of its own, its cwd being documented as * the child's "workspace identity" (`dsh-subagent/lib/types/out-of-process.js`: * `resolveChildCwd`/`assertUsableCwd`). An in-process child copies its parent's cwd verbatim * (`…/child-agent.js:childSessionMeta`), so the two agree there; this rule is what makes the plugin's * answer independent of which of those two shapes it is handed. * * A session the registry does not account is NOT refused: `sameWorkspace` answers true when either * side's workspace is unknown, so an unaccounted or memory-only session keeps exactly the view it had * before this term existed. UNKNOWN DEGRADES TO SELF on the lineage half and TO THE OLD ANSWER here — * never to a guess, and never to a refusal the reader cannot see the reason for. * * UNKNOWN DEGRADES TO SELF, never to a guess: with no recorded lineage and no header facts every * session is its own root, so only the requester matches — byte-for-byte today's behaviour. A cycle * (which no shell should produce) stops at the first repeat, and the walk is bounded by * {@link MAX_LINEAGE_DEPTH}. * * TWO THINGS A MERGED VIEW DOES NOT MERGE, so the next reader does not expect them: * comments stay per-session (`comments` is read with the requester's id, so a merged list shows the * requester's threads only), and undo stacks stay per-lineage — every ACTION records its pair under the * canonical session of the seat that PRESSED it, so the seats of one lineage share one history and a * different lineage cannot reach into it (`undoStackOf`/`popOwnPair` are keyed by that root). The * session-scoped thing a merged press does NOT take from the ROW is the write policy: an action's file * write runs under the REQUESTING session's own workspace and sandbox (see * `DiffApprovalUndoPair.policySession`), never the owner's. ```

### Q04 · 成本、受控试用与新的恢复假设是什么？ **研究主题**：依赖、兼容与流程、效果与总成本、采用判断、新假设与验证 #### 完整回答 启动依赖fs/connection/webServer/workspaceRegistry/sessions/controller/agents及客户端模块与React，VCS导入还需相关CLI。普通人工审阅无强制模型调用，评论/AI协作另有模型费。首次要固定宿主/备份和理解Keep/Revert，持续为old/new全文件内存/JSON、diff渲染、外改检测及人工逐块核查，失败恢复要区分已写/未写与持久失败；金额、峰值与人时未知。Markdown预览用DOMPurify可减少直接HTML注入，但不是所有网络/文件面的安全验收。 建议单人可备份工作树试用事后审阅，创建文件删除不可undo先确认，回退前冻结其他写入并查实际文件，保留Git/备份。多来源同文件或敏感全局快照先观察。未验证假设是版本绑定动作收据和删除恢复包，所有revert/undo带expected hash，批量记录逐项已写并将持久结果回给UI。由普通回退和部分恢复/持久弱确认推导，可能减少覆盖/误以为持久，但增加存储和冲突交互。最小验证回退前/检查后外改、创建删除、写满磁盘和批量中断，对照丢改、可恢复与人工操作；若仍覆盖或UI误报耐久则否定。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:102-102](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/src/index.ts#L102-L102) Host必需服务。 ```text export const inject = ['fs', 'connection', 'webServer', 'workspaceRegistry', 'sessions', 'sessionController', 'agents'] ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/client/markdown-preview.ts:699-703](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/src/client/markdown-preview.ts#L699-L703) 预览净化。 ```text /** Render one top-level token's Markdown, sanitized, as detached elements. */ function renderToken(raw: string): HTMLElement[] { const holder = document.createElement('div') holder.innerHTML = DOMPurify.sanitize(marked.parse(raw, { async: false }) as string) return [...holder.children].filter((node): node is HTMLElement => node instanceof HTMLElement) ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:2057-2075](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval/blob/c6edcac3d89968e1213ce61ce2c52435aefefd05/src/index.ts#L2057-L2075) 删除与普通回退边界导出假设。
